record.field: FCL, LCL and break-bulk shipping to major ports worldwide, with consolidation and shipment tracking.

field.name: body
field.p: FCL, LCL, break-bulk and RORO shipments to and from any major port worldwide, through our partner and agent network. We handle consolidation, documentation and carrier selection and keep you updated from origin to destination.

ul.li: FCL, LCL, break-bulk and RORO
Specialist LCL consolidation (consol boxes) to the UK, USA, Mediterranean and Australia
Multimodal transport, vendor consolidation and purchase-order management
Available as either a freight forwarder or NVOCC
Non-containerisable cargo: conventional vessels, barges, lighters
Cargo insurance can be arranged on request — ask your coordinator about coverage for your shipment.

record.field: Air cargo for time-sensitive shipments. We pick carriers based on your budget and how fast it needs to get there.

field.name: body
field.p: When speed matters, we start with your transit time, budget and handling needs, then recommend the carrier and service level — not the other way round.

ul.li: Consultative carrier and routing selection
Consolidation, customs clearance and shipment-status tracking
Support for time-critical shipments to any city or country

record.field: Door-to-door road freight across India, connecting origin points to ports, ICDs and final destinations.

field.name: body
field.p: Our road transport service links factories, warehouses, ports and ICDs across India, for both full-load and part-load requirements.
Whether your cargo has to reach a port for export or move from a port to its final destination, we plan the road leg as part of the same shipment, not as a separate job.

ul.li: Full truckload and part-load options
Port-to-door and door-to-port movement
Scheduling matched to your shipment timeline

record.field: Customs clearance at Indian ports and ICDs, with careful handling of documentation and compliance.

field.name: body
field.p: Customs paperwork is usually the slowest part of a shipment — so we handle it in-house. As a licensed Customs House Agent (CHA) with our own clearance team, we manage classification, valuation, documentation and clearance at major Indian ports and ICDs, keeping control of your cargo at every step with predictable release timelines.

ul.li: Licensed CHA — in-house customs clearance department
Expedited releases at virtually any port or ICD in India
Classification & valuation expertise
Automated customs clearance and documentation
Customized management reports
Customs-bond underwriting
Sector experience: textiles, medical & pharmaceutical, heavy machinery, automobile and project cargo — including new-plant set-up and commissioning
Senior brokers who have cleared India’s highest customs examinations

record.field: Freight, documentation and carrier management handled together, so you deal with one team instead of several vendors.

field.name: body
field.p: Freight coordination, documentation, carrier management and customs, all under one point of contact — so you’re not chasing multiple vendors.

ul.li: One coordinator from sourcing through to delivery
Multimodal freight, documentation and customs under one team
End-to-end shipment visibility
Backed by a 500+ agent network worldwide

record.field: Moving your cargo from the port or warehouse to its final destination.

field.name: body
field.p: Once your cargo has cleared customs or reached a warehouse, our distribution team takes over the last leg.
We arrange the road transport, scheduling and documentation needed to get it to its final destination.

record.field: Ambient, temperature-controlled, racked and bulk storage, with cross-dock and JIT programmes.

field.name: body
field.p: We provide warehousing and distribution for cargo that needs storage before onward transport. Our facilities combine modern systems with best-practice handling to lower storage and distribution costs while raising service levels.

ul.li: Storage: ambient, temperature-controlled (air-conditioned, chilled, frozen), racked and bulk
Computerized inventory-control systems
24-hour monitored security and fire protection
Trained, certified staff and modern material-handling equipment
Cross-dock and just-in-time (JIT) programmes
Owned truck fleet, 3–13 tonne capacity
Warehousing at major cities and near key airports/seaports

record.field: Planning and coordination for oversized, heavy or multi-part shipments.

field.name: body
field.p: Oversized, heavy or multi-part cargo can’t be treated like a standard shipment. It needs planning. Our project cargo team coordinates the movement of this kind of cargo from origin to destination.
We work with you from the planning stage through transport and delivery, and run the whole thing as one project rather than a string of separate moves.

record.field: Support for POE shipments and DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) movements, mainly for US-bound cargo.

field.name: body
field.p: We offer DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipment support, mainly for US-bound shipments, and take on duty and delivery responsibility as part of the arrangement.
